mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 3% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 for two consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous and persistent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST for three consecutive months signals a broad-based weakening in economic activity, which depresses earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 60% of joint-triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in FEDFUNDS of more than 0.75 percentage points signals an aggressive tightening, which immediately raises risk-free rates and equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative after such a FEDFUNDS hike.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS rises above its 12-month moving average simultaneously for two months, it signals a labor market rebalancing toward higher employment but stable wage growth, which supports corporate margins and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% AND PAYEMS > 12-month moving average for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals strong household savings, which may reflect precautionary behavior and reduced consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month moving average for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
